Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly extract the birth year from the WebSurfer's search results. In Step 2, the WebSurfer explicitly displayed the text "Edward VII Date of birth Nov 9, 1841" and "Born 9 November 1841". However, in Step 3, the Planner incorrectly stated that the birth year was 1865. This contradicts the evidence provided in the previous step and the actual historical fact (Edward VII was born in 1841; 1865 is the birth year of George V, who appears in the same search results). The Planner accepted an incorrect value without verifying it against the visible source data.
